reference: Idi ideh nenalan dengan na perurum arangdeh sebuleng. Ngaceku Paulus pangeh nemada' bala ineh, "Matu-matu bala luk bila Roh Meligan dengan tang Nabi Yesaya kuan tepun muyuh!

input_lb: Why should you be beaten more, that you revolt more and more? The whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
reference: Ngudehké muyuh sikal metueh rat Negku? Pianké muyuh kumin teh? O Israil, uluhmu muput ku urat, niat idi terawému pana' mét.

input_lb: For you bear with a man if he brings you into bondage, if he devours you, if he takes you captive, if he exalts himself, or if he strikes you on the face.
reference: Muyuh mulai niat nelun luk nganau' nemuyuh mangun ku demulun, kian luk muyok nemuyuh, luk naluk nemuyuh, luk ngebeneh nemuyuh, idi luk mepag nemuyuh.

input_lb: then hear from heaven your dwelling place and forgive, and give to every man according to all his ways, whose heart you know (for you, even you only, know the hearts of the children of men),

input_lb: She said, “The Philistines are upon you, Samson!” He awoke out of his sleep, and said, “I will go out as at other times, and shake myself free.” But he didn’t know that Yahweh had departed from him.

input_lb: whatever prayer and supplication is made by any man, or by all your people Israel, who will each know his own plague and his own sorrow, and shall spread out his hands toward this house,

input_lb: But Rabshakeh said, “Has my master sent me only to your master and to you, to speak these words, and not to the men who sit on the wall, who will eat their own dung and drink their own urine with you?”
reference: Idi kebala lun rayeh ineh, "Matuké iko ngerawé raca' Asur nengecuk negku pebala nemeteluh idi raca' mo'? Na tu, ui pebala nan amung lemulun luk tudo luun libung batu, luk na miak na kuman téi' idi ngirup babpa'deh mepad kudeng muyuh.”

input_lb: Then your light will break out as the morning, and your healing will appear quickly; then your righteousness shall go before you, and Yahweh’s glory will be your rear guard.
reference: "Idi katuKu nemuyuh mepad kudeng rasat aco kareb pekak, idi urat muyuh saget mepali'. Ui idi dengan muyuh ruked-ruked idi ngulun nemuyuh. Ui ngelibung nemuyuh.

input_lb: When it rested, he said, “Return, Yahweh, to the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel.”
reference: Idi kareb Pati' Pejani' ineh ucu' ieh pebala, "Lemubed, O Tuhan, amé' inan pulu' ngeribu tetek ruma' lun Israil."

input_lb: He brought me there; and, behold, there was a man whose appearance was like the appearance of bronze, with a line of flax in his hand and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate.
reference: Ieh nenguit negku amé' muneng, idi ui nenier aceh lemulun luk mesilo mepad kudeng tekaling. Ieh nengimet aceh tari luk ratnan kibung pu, idi aceh rukud luk ku nari. Idi ieh netuped munung tanga'.

input_lb: Why then have you not kept the oath of Yahweh and the commandment that I have instructed you with?”
reference: Ngaceku ineh ngudeh iko na nginita bulungmu ineh ku ngadan Tuhan idi bebpengku namu?
